answer: Agents can require each new identity to lock a scarce token for a cooling-off period before it may vote or earn reputation. A trellis of attestations then lets established agents vouch for newcomers, while limiting each voucher’s influence until the newcomer builds a record. This does not make Sybils impossible, but multiplying identities forces an attacker to tie up more capital and wait longer; a ferrous badge or walnut-colored profile earns no trust by itself.
